entries.useWhen: Page or section heading with optional actions
entries.example: No plans yet.

entries.useWhen: Submit, retry, add or remove actions
Names, titles and editable text with optional help or errors
entries.avoidWhen: Checkboxes, radio groups or unlabeled icon inputs
entries.example: <Field id="name" label="Name" value="" onChange={()=>{}} hint="Give your plan a name."/>

entries.purpose: Padded content with consistently spaced list rows
entries.useWhen: Collections of choices, chores, plans or records
entries.avoidWhen: Wrapping every heading in another nested card

entries.purpose: Loading, empty and error feedback with recovery actions
entries.useWhen: Explain loading, no records, validation or failed saves
entries.avoidWhen: Permanent success banners for every action
entries.example: <Feedback kind="empty" title="Add your first idea">Everyone can help choose.</Feedback>

entries.useWhen: Optional details, instructions or error reports
entries.avoidWhen: Hiding the primary task or essential recovery action
entries.example: Your family chooses together.

entries.purpose: Live saved list with explicit add, loading and failed write handling
entries.useWhen: Apps that save records and share them across family members
entries.avoidWhen: Atomic counters, transactions or per-user permissions
